# Provenance

One path of the stock MegaMud v2.2 path set, for card C-086: `Dthhstt1.mp` (Dragon's Teeth
Hills (Hole) to the Stone Tunnel), which starts with `@party go hole` in a room 22 rooms of the
hills share a MegaMud room id with. The hole is 2/487's (its command text casts *fall* into
2/1306); the path's walk placed the step in 2/193. Copied on 2026-11-10, byte for byte, from
this repository's `data/megamud/Default/` at commit
`bfa9fc1d4bbb596a6b3513add74e7182dfd0a75d` (its own provenance is `data/megamud/PROVENANCE.md`).

The test pack is built from `tests/fixtures/megamud` with these files added beside it
(`crates/wayfarer-world/tests/common/mod.rs`). Do not edit these files; a card that needs other
paths adds its own subdirectory.
